create_SpendUpdateQueue: create a SpendUpdateQueue instance to buffer in-memory spend updates before committing to the database
add_update_to_queue: add a spend update item to the in-memory queue with entity type, entity id, and response cost
aggregate_queue_updates: aggregate all spend update items in the queue by entity type and entity id to reduce queue size
flush_and_get_aggregated_db_spend_update: flush all queued updates and return aggregated DB spend update transactions grouped by entity type
get_aggregated_db_spend_update_transacti: aggregate a list of spend update items into DBSpendUpdateTransactions grouped by entity type and id
